name: Diploma in Catering Management
notes: Qual code DICTM1. CAO code DU-D-CKM. Campus: Ritson (Hotel School, Block D). No minimum APS stated. Accounting (Level 3) is stated as compulsory, although the table lists Mathematics OR Mathematical Literacy OR Accounting; modelled as Accounting plus Maths/Maths Lit. Level 2 (30%) Mathematics accepted, below the usual Level 3 minimum. Mathematical Literacy accepted (Level 3); same APS. Also requires two recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 3. Suitability test, then possible interview. Preference for catering/hospitality/management subjects, industry experience or CATHSSETA/NQF 4 qualifications. Hepatitis A vaccination (primary and booster) required; uniform, kitchen toolkit and texts at the learner's cost. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places.

name: Diploma in Ecotourism
notes: Qual code DPECT2. CAO code DU-P-ET3. Campus: Riverside (Pietermaritzburg). Minimum 25 points (excl. LO). Mathematical Literacy accepted (Level 5); same APS. Also requires two recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 3. Preference for CATHSSETA units or a relevant NQF 4 certificate; ranking system if oversubscribed. Substantial time spent in industry. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places.

notes: Qual code DIHSP1. CAO code DU-D-HPM. Campus: Ritson (Hotel School, Block D). No minimum APS stated. Level 2 (30%) Mathematics accepted, below the usual Level 3 minimum.
